evidence.quote: What I want to talk about is central bank independence but applied to Reserve Bank operations.
So I proposed centralizing and standardizing back-office functions and having the Reserve Banks focus on the things they uniquely provide to their Districts.
Bank presidents and first vice presidents need to adopt a "System first, Bank second" mindset.
